data.description:
Tool 'finish' from the SWE-Next SFT harness. 2,831 calls, every one with command=submit.
The 'result' parameter is always a free-text natural-language summary of the fix (unique per trajectory, e.g. 'Added support for Cisco dotted MAC notation...', 'Fixed KeyError when pass-fail criteria missing 'label' in JUnitXMLReporter...').
The harness ends a trajectory with a prose work summary, not a machine-readable verdict.

data.description:
Tool-call surface of the SWE-Next SFT harness: XML-ish tags inside assistant messages. Well-formed calls look like <function=file_editor>\n  <parameter=command>view</parameter>\n  <parameter=path>/testbed</parameter>\n</function>.
Distinct function names observed: file_editor, search, execute_bash, finish — a fixed 4-tool surface, no other tool names in 3,693 rows.
Malformed invocations observed in the corpus (model-authored, pre-cleanup): 166 rows contain empty '<function=>' tags; 54 parameter tags with non-identifier names (50 under search, 4 under file_editor) where the model wrote broken tool attempts into prose (e.g. '<parameter=}]}Can't include trailing garbage. Let's call properly.}]}```').
Behavioral note: the SFT corpus retains the expert model's own tool-format fumbles — format-retry chatter is part of the trained surface.

data.description:
Model attribution for the SWE-Next SFT trajectory corpus: UNVERIFIED.
The dataset card (TIGER-Lab/SWE-Next-SFT-Trajectories README.md, retrieved 2026-10-08) says the 3,693 ShareGPT-style examples are 'collected from expert agent rollouts' but names no rollout model. The api_card.json tags the dataset with arxiv:2603.20691 and links released models SWE-Next-7B / SWE-Next-14B — those are downstream products trained on this corpus, not the expert rollout models.
System prompt is identical in all 3,693 rows: 'You are a programming agent who is provided a github issue and repository bash environment and is tasked to solve certain tasks (e.g., file localization, testcase generation, code repair and editing etc) to resolve the issue.'
No model name is verifiable from the source docs; do not attribute these trajectories to a named model without independent evidence.
